notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around standard federation save and restore lifecycle callbacks. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies suppression and release of save initiation/completion, save-status, restore initiation/status, and restore-completion callbacks, exact labels and identity metadata, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with requestFederationSave/federateSaveBegun/federateSaveComplete/queryFederationSaveStatus/requestFederationRestore/queryFederationRestoreStatus/federateRestoreComplete and FederateAmbassador save/restore callback delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and save/restore declarations
